title: kotlin.UninitializedPropertyAccessException: lateinit property has not been initialized (Spring bean)
errorSample:
kotlin.UninitializedPropertyAccessException: lateinit property discountPolicy has not been initialized
    at task.PriceQuoteService.getDiscountPolicy(Application.kt:26)
    at task.PriceQuoteService.quote(Application.kt:29)
    at task.PriceQuoteServiceTests.일반 회원은 할인이 없다(PriceQuoteServiceTests.kt:21)
symptom: The application context starts normally, but the first call that uses a collaborator throws kotlin.UninitializedPropertyAccessException: "lateinit property discountPolicy has not been initialized".
cause: The collaborator is declared as a lateinit var in a Spring bean but nothing asks Spring to inject it. Without @Autowired (or a constructor parameter) Spring never assigns the field, so it stays uninitialized.
fixSummary: Prefer constructor injection: declare the collaborator as a private val in the primary constructor and remove the lateinit var. Alternatively keep the field and annotate it with @Autowired.
